purpose: Require every repository that presents itself as participating in the governance floor to declare its relationship to the Evaluation Kit environment contract.

evaluation_kit_environment_status.claim_effect: The base-image identity is pinned, but network dependency acquisition still prevents an offline, hermetic, or fully supply-chain-isolated claim.

governing_rules: A repository must not imply membership in the pinned floor merely because it uses Node or npm.
A repository outside the pinned profile must explicitly declare NOT_ON_PINNED_FLOOR or another truthful bounded relationship.
A compatible version range is not identical to an exact pinned environment.
A cache hit is not a vendored or independently preserved dependency set.
A digest-pinned base image does not make network dependency acquisition offline or hermetic.
Environment declaration is not execution evidence.
Account-wide alignment is not complete until every affected repository has an attributable declaration.
nonclaims: This policy does not classify all 52 repositories as environment-aligned.
This policy does not establish independent reproduction, hermeticity, supply-chain security, or runtime success.
This policy does not change the Evaluation Kit registry or expected results.
The pinned digest becomes execution-supported only when the exact digest-bound Evaluation Kit head completes successfully.
review_triggers: Docker base tag or digest change
GitHub runner or action identity change
